name: regulatory associated protein of MTOR complex 1
pathways: positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase III

function.text: RPTOR encodes regulatory-associated protein of mTOR (p150 target of rapamycin (TOR)-scaffold protein). Annotated molecular activities include enzyme-substrate adaptor activity and protein-macromolecule adaptor activity. It participates in positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase III and TOR signaling.

function.text: RPTOR encodes regulatory-associated protein of mTOR (p150 target of rapamycin (TOR)-scaffold protein). Based in part on similarity, it forms part of the mechanistic target of rapamycin complex 1 (mTORC1), an evolutionarily conserved central nutrient sensor that stimulates anabolic reactions and macromolecule biosynthesis to promote cellular biomass generation and growth. The mTORC1 complex is inhibited in response to starvation and amino acid depletion.
